repos_data.description: ⚠️ Superseded by nikicat/browser-web3-signer — MCP server that routes blockchain transactions to browser wallets for signing

Portable memory for AI agents — enterprise-ready production thin-client. Seals agent memory client-side (ML-DSA-65 / AES-256-GCM / ML-KEM-768) and stores opaque ciphertext on the blind, non-custodial SAIHM /mcp endpoint. Pairs with @saihm/client-pro and @saihm/mcp-server.
Free non-custodial Swap API — Solana (Jupiter) + 7 EVM chains (KyberSwap) + universal cross-chain router + priority-fee oracle. Returns unsigned transactions for YOUR wallet. No API key, no KYC.
MCP server for Shieldz, the non-custodial crypto payment gateway. AI agents create invoices and accept crypto payments with $0 platform fees.
